title: Worldwide sphere reports after the 2021 broadcast

tellings.quote: And so I was getting phone calls, messages, emails from people all over the world, including I remember a beautiful guy in Africa who who told me that they were seeing these spheres.

plain: After a 2021 broadcast, people around the world are said to have come forward saying they were seeing spheres in the sky. The journalist Ross Coulthart says he got phone calls, messages and emails from all over the world, including from "a beautiful guy in Africa" who told him they were seeing these spheres. He tells it as a sign that the sightings were not limited to one place.
